guidance: Ironclad A0 at 65/80 HP and 127 gold; only next node is Unknown row4/col2. The prior Self Help Book gave Molten Fist Sharp+2 (12 damage once per combat because it exhausts). If the unknown node is combat, use fresh intents, block dangerous attacks, and take guaranteed lethal; the native guard filters only proven dominated basic-card end turns. One Explosive Ampoule is held; use it to avoid meaningful HP loss or shorten a scaling fight, not on an already-safe board. At card reward choose reliable immediate damage, block, draw or energy; don't force an archetype. End at the next MAP after resolving the room.
